nodes.meaning: One exact request evaluated against one immutable fixture base tree.

One initialized App Server lifecycle bound to an explicit proposal-only no-effect request context and one ephemeral read-only thread, with model-side approvals denied and transport closure guaranteed.
Exact final bytes returned by one injected model transport and bound to the deterministic prompt that requested them.
Untrusted captured bytes parsed into one closed replace-file proposal bound to exact base and file digests.
Explicit approve-each decision bound to one canonical action identity.
Result candidate returned by the separately invoked verifier and bound by its digest.
Bounded result whose exact changed paths are within the allowlist and whose focused check passed.
Terminal state for an effect that may have happened but lacks a trustworthy observation; automatic retry is forbidden.
No fixture mutation occurs before approval of the exact canonical action identity.
Patch-candidate status requires a separate verifier process to prove exact base/post trees, changed-path allowlist, protected-file preservation, and focused-check success.

invariants.expression: live session implies initialized lifecycle and explicit proposal_only no_effect request_context and ephemeral thread and read_only sandbox and model_approval_policy == never and close_attempted
model output is untrusted final bytes and never grants effect authority
effect iff candidate valid and base current and path allowlisted and exact action approved
PATCH_CANDIDATE iff separate_verifier == PASS_BOUNDED and changed_paths subset_of mutation_allowlist

claim_limit: Candidate capability-local meaning only; no ontology admission, production effect enforcement, or external-effect authority.
